name: Bilt Mastercard®
notes: The only card that earns points on rent payments with NO transaction fees. Issued by Wells Fargo on behalf of Bilt Rewards. Must make at least 5 transactions per statement period to earn points.

tripDelay.notes: Up to $200 per trip when common carrier is delayed 4+ hours. Requires a minimum 2 night stay for hotel coverage.

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation and interruption protection up to $5,000 per person when travel is charged to the card.

lostBaggage.notes: Lost baggage reimbursement as a Mastercard World Elite benefit.

baggageDelay.notes: Coverage for baggage delays of 4+ hours.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Travel accident insurance included as a Mastercard World Elite benefit when common carrier fare is charged to card.

emergencyMedical.notes: No dedicated emergency medical evacuation benefit.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Primary auto rental coverage as a Mastercard World Elite benefit. Decline CDW from rental company. Up to $50,000 for collision/theft.

globalEntryTSA.notes: Up to $120 credit for Global Entry ($100) or TSA PreCheck ($85) application fee, once every 4 years.

rewards.baseRate: 1x Bilt Points per $1 on all other purchases
rewards.travelRate: 2x on travel (airfare, hotels, car rentals, cruises)
otherBonusCategories: 1x on rent (up to 100,000 points/year) — NO transaction fees, unique to Bilt
6x on dining/travel/rent on Rent Day (1st of each month)
1x on all other purchases (minimum 5 transactions/month required to earn points)

pointValue.transferPartners: 1:1 transfer to American Airlines, United, Alaska, Air Canada Aeroplan, Flying Blue (AF/KL), British Airways, Cathay Pacific, Emirates, TAP Air Portugal, IHG, Hyatt, Marriott, and more. Bilt points are considered some of the most valuable transferable currency available.

travelPerks: Earn 1x points on rent — NO transaction fees (up to 100,000 points/year)
3x on dining, 2x on travel, 1x on all other purchases
Double points on Rent Day (1st of each month): 6x dining/travel/rent
Primary rental car coverage (Mastercard World Elite benefit)
$120 Global Entry/TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
Lost baggage up to $3,000; baggage delay after 4 hours
Transfer to 14+ airline and hotel partners at 1:1 ratio (including Hyatt, United, AA, British Airways)
Transfer to Hyatt at 1:1 (exceptional value for luxury hotel stays)
Lyft Pink All Access membership (complimentary, activate through Bilt app)
bestFor: Renters who want to turn monthly rent into valuable travel rewards with no transaction fees — the only card that does this. Exceptional transfer partners make points especially valuable.
